prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. T7 image-to-3D concept asset. One isolated object/module centered, full object visible with generous white margin, PURE SOLID WHITE background, soft even diffuse light, NO cast ground shadow or ambient shadow patch, NO ground plane or scenic base. Stylized LOW-POLY geometry, simplified planar forms, hand-painted texture feel, Ming dynasty architecture. Match style_master ONLY for muted ochre brick, slate-blue roof, grey-green foliage, red-brown columns, ivory walls and restrained ink/watercolor material feel. This is a model-ready object concept, not a paper map or photorealistic building. No text, labels, Chinese characters, numbers, watermark, people, presentation frame or multiple views on a single sheet. Requested 1536x1536 square. For masonry and buildings, absolutely NO incidental vegetation, shrubs, trees, moss, grass, decorative rocks or scenery unless explicitly part of asset. Avoid photographic realism and excessive surface microdetail. Asset X03 (夫人城). Lady's City: small projecting SQUARE outer fortified enclosure connected to an L-shaped main-city northwest wall corner; enclosed square platform with crenellated parapets, battered grey-brick facing over earth core, about 70 relative units perimeter and 11 high. No grand tower, garden, stele or river; show wall geometry clearly. MAIN VIEW: front-right three-quarter camera, 45-degree downward elevation, one object fully visible.
